recommendations.recommendation: Keep repo map_cube_grid_v0 as the bounded container. Use Red Blob only for horizontal hex addressing and TTG only for terrace-height concepts.
Store q and r as primary axial fields, store or derive s=-q-r, and keep vertical z/final_height separate from cube-coordinate s.
Generate final vertex/face arrays from internal terrain cells and feed Blender Mesh.from_pydata; validate and update each mesh.
Emit top hex faces and side/riser faces only when neighbor absence or height delta exposes a face; use mesh-list selection/mask concepts for helper design.
Classify all six Red Blob neighbor directions using fold/terrace height deltas into flat, step, ledge, cliff, boundary, and structure edge roles.
Use Red Blob line/range/ring algorithms for route generation and accept Tiled polylines as optional authored input.
Use Tiled rectangles/polygons as v0 plot templates; keep LDtk entities as a deferred alternative for authored templates.
Represent sockets as Tiled points/rectangles or future LDtk entities with typed properties for socket_type, orientation, asset_ref, and semantic tags.
Use direct mesh data APIs and optional curve splines; avoid context-sensitive edit-mode operators and booleans for v0 proof renders.
Build graph nodes from hex cells and graph edges from six neighbor directions; attach movement, hazard, cover, connector, line-of-sight, and plot tags from map layers.
Do not implement full WFC in v0; define socket compatibility records first and later map models/sockets/rules to ghx_proc_gen or another solver if needed.
Keep CadQuery and Manifold deferred; consider them only if parametric CAD export or robust booleans become necessary after Blender proof pipeline stabilizes.
